quote: The Company was not required to apply fresh start accounting based on the provisions of Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”) 852, Reorganizations, since the entity’s reorganization value immediately before the date of confirmation was more than the total of all its post-petition liabilities and allowed claims.
issuer_treatment: Structure historique : transition HPC à partir de mars 2024, dépendance à un seul client HPC anonyme, majorité du revenu 2024 encore minage. Sortie de Chapter 11 janvier 2024 sans fresh-start accounting ; ne pas considérer cela comme une faillite actuelle 2026.
